# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 13, 2026.


# Platform

script Array<WsfPlatform> FindPlatformsOfType(string p_type)
   Array<WsfPlatform> result = Array<WsfPlatform>();
   for (int i = 0; i < WsfSimulation.PlatformCount(); i = i + 1) {
      WsfPlatform p = WsfSimulation.PlatformEntry(i);
      if (p.IsValid() && p.Type().EndsWith(p_type)) result.PushBack(p);
   }
   return result;
end_script

script bool PlatformTurnToPoint(WsfPlatform p, WsfGeoPoint t)
   if (!p.IsValid() || t.IsNull()) return false;
   double heading_offset = p.RelativeBearingTo(t);
   return p.TurnToRelativeHeading(heading_offset);
end_script

script WsfPlatform DeployPlatform(WsfPlatform source, string deploy_type, string command_chain, string extra_inputs)
   if (source.IsNull() || deploy_type.Length() <= 0) return null;
   WsfPlatform p = WsfSimulation.CreatePlatform(deploy_type);
   p.SetSide(source.Side());
   p.SetLocation(source.Location());
   if (command_chain.Length() > 0) p.SetCommander(command_chain, source);
   if (extra_inputs.Length() > 0) p.ProcessInput(extra_inputs);
   return WsfSimulation.AddPlatform(p, "");
end_script

# Track

script bool TrackTargetHasCategory(WsfTrack t, string category_name)
   return t.IsValid() && t.Target().IsValid() && t.Target().CategoryMemberOf(category_name);
end_script

# Weapon

script struct GetWeaponAuxInfo(WsfWeapon w)
   # aux_data
   #    double range = 120000.0 # in meter
   #    string t_category = "air missile"
   #    double launch_interval = 5.0 # seconds
   #    double last_launch_time = -99999 # sim time
   #    double required_track_quality = 0.85
   # end_aux_data
   struct c = struct();
   c->range = w.AuxDataDouble("range");
   c->t_category = w.AuxDataString("t_category");
   c->launch_interval = w.AuxDataDouble("launch_interval");
   c->last_launch_time = w.AuxDataDouble("last_launch_time");
   c->required_track_quality = w.AuxDataDouble("required_track_quality");
   return c;
end_script

script bool WeaponCanAttackTarget(WsfWeapon w, WsfTrack t)
      if (!w.IsValid() || !t.IsValid()) {
         return false;
      }
      struct w_info = GetWeaponAuxInfo(w);
      if (w_info->last_launch_time + w_info->launch_interval > TIME_NOW) {
         return false;
      }
      if (t.Quality() < w_info->required_track_quality) {
         return false;
      }
      string category = w_info->t_category;
      if (!category.Contains("any")) {
         if (TrackTargetHasCategory(t, "air") && !category.Contains("air")) {
            return false;
         }
         if (TrackTargetHasCategory(t, "surface") && !category.Contains("surface")) {
            return false;
         }
         if (TrackTargetHasCategory(t, "missile") && !category.Contains("missile")) {
            return false;
         }
      }
      if (t.CurrentLocation().SlantRangeTo(w.Platform().Location()) > w_info->range) {
         return false;
      }
      return true;
end_script

script bool ForceFireWeapon(WsfWeapon w, WsfTrack track)
   if (w.IsValid() && track.IsValid()) {
      bool success = w.Fire(track);
      if (success) {
         w.SetAuxData("last_launch_time", TIME_NOW);
      }
      return success;
   }
   return false;
end_script

      update_interval 1 s
   end_mover

      transfer_rate 200 mbits/s
      internal_link data_mgr
      internal_link perception
   end_comm

      purge_interval 60 s
      report_to command_chain air commander via t_comm
   end_processor

      on
      reporting_self true
      reporting_others true

   end_processor

         elevation_measurement_sigma 0.1 deg
         process_noise_sigmas_XYZ 50 50 50
      end_filter
   end_track_manager

         Array<WsfPlatform> nimitzs = FindPlatformsOfType("NIMITZ_CARRIER");
         foreach (WsfPlatform p in nimitzs) {
            if (p.Side() != PLATFORM.Side()) continue;
            if (mother_ship.IsNull()) mother_ship = p;
            else {
               if (PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(p) < PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(mother_ship)) mother_ship = p;
            }
         }
         max_chase_speed = 410;
         keep_distance = true;
         distance_to_keep = 2000;
         max_cruise_speed = 460;
         cruise_altitude = 8000;
         minimum_cruise_distance = 40000;
         threat_processor = (WsfThreatProcessor) PLATFORM.Processor("threat_proc");
         writeln(PLATFORM.Name() + " has initialized. Mother ship is " + mother_ship.Name());
      end_on_initialize
      
      update_interval 3 s
   end_processor
   
end_platform_type

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 7, 2026.



processor CARRIER_WEAPON_TASKER WSF_QUANTUM_TASKER_PROCESSOR 
   script_debug_writes disable
   script bool WeaponFitTarget(WsfWeapon w, WsfTrack track)
      if (!w.IsValid() || !track.IsValid()) return false;
      string category = w.AuxDataString("t_category");
      if (!"any".StartsWith(category)) {
         if (
            (track.AirDomain() && !category.Contains("air")) ||
            (track.SurfaceDomain() && !category.Contains("surface"))
         ) return false;
      }
      return true;
   end_script
   
   script Array<WsfQuantumTask> GenerateWeaponTask(Array<WsfLocalTrack> t, Array<WsfAssetPerception> a)
      Array<WsfQuantumTask> res = Array<WsfQuantumTask>();
      foreach (WsfLocalTrack lt in t) {
         if (lt.Target().IsValid() && !lt.Target().CategoryMemberOf("missile")) {
            double priority = lt.Speed() * 1000 / PLATFORM.GroundRangeTo(lt);
            res.PushBack(WsfQuantumTask.Construct(priority, "weapon", lt));
         }
      }
      return res;
   end_script

   script double WeaponEvaluate (WsfQuantumTask task, WsfAssetPerception asset)
      writeln_d(asset);
      WsfTrackId t_id = task.LocalTrackId();
      WsfTrack track = PLATFORM.MasterTrackList().FindTrack(t_id);
      WsfPlatform platform = WsfSimulation.FindPlatform(asset.Index());
      if (!track.IsValid() || !platform.IsValid()) return 0.0;
      int w_cnt = platform.WeaponCount();
      if (w_cnt <= 0) return 0.0;
      double base_score = 0.0;
      WsfWeapon w = null;
      for (int i = 0; i < w_cnt; i = i + 1) {
         w = platform.WeaponEntry(i);
         if (!w.IsValid() || w.QuantityRemaining() <= 0) continue;
         if (WeaponFitTarget(w, track)) break;
      }
      if (w == null) return 0.0;
      base_score = base_score + 10.0 + w.QuantityRemaining();
      double distance = platform.Location().SlantRangeTo(track.CurrentLocation());
      double heading_offset = MATH.Fabs(platform.RelativeBearingTo(track.CurrentLocation()));
      base_score = base_score - heading_offset / 18;
      base_score = base_score * task.Priority();
      writeln_d(platform.Name() + " against " + track.TargetName() + " score = " + (string)base_score);
      return base_score / ((distance - w.AuxDataDouble("range")) / 500);
   end_script

   update_interval 30 s
   asset_representation platform
   generator custom GenerateWeaponTask
   evaluator custom WeaponEvaluate
   allocator greedy_priority 
   reallocation_strategy dynamic
end_processor

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 7, 2026.

processor CRUISE_MISSILE_GUIDER WSF_TASK_PROCESSOR 
   script_variables 
      double cruise_height = 150; # in meter
      double rise_speed = 6; # m/s
      double cruise_speed = 245; # m/s
   end_script_variables
   
   evaluation_interval RISING 0.5 s
   evaluation_interval CRUISE 10 s
   evaluation_interval TERMINATE 0.1 s
   
   state RISING
      next_state CRUISE
         if (PLATFORM.Altitude() >= cruise_height) return true;
         PLATFORM.SetVelocityNED(0.0, 0.0, -rise_speed);
         return false;
      end_next_state
   end_state
   
   state CRUISE
      next_state TERMINATE
         if (PLATFORM.Location().SlantRangeTo(TRACK.CurrentLocation()) < PLATFORM.Speed() * 10)
            return true;
         WsfGeoPoint t = TRACK.LocationAtTime(1);
         t.SetAltitudeAGL(cruise_height);
         double bearing = PLATFORM.RelativeBearingTo(t);
         PLATFORM.TurnToRelativeHeading(bearing);
         PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(cruise_speed);
         PLATFORM.GoToAltitude(cruise_height);
         return false;
      end_next_state
   end_state
   
   state TERMINATE
      next_state CRUISE
         if (PLATFORM.Location().SlantRangeTo(TRACK.CurrentLocation()) > PLATFORM.Speed() * 10)
            return true;
         WsfGeoPoint t = TRACK.CurrentLocation();
         double bearing = PLATFORM.RelativeBearingTo(t);
         PLATFORM.TurnToRelativeHeading(bearing);
         PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(cruise_speed);
         PLATFORM.GoToAltitude(t.Altitude());
         return false;
      end_next_state
   end_state
end_processor

文件路径: common\processors\within_range_launch.txt
============================================================

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 7, 2026.

processor WITHIN_RANGE_LAUNCH WSF_TASK_PROCESSOR
   script_debug_writes disable
   script_variables 
      string w_name;
      double required_track_quality = 0.85;
   end_script_variables
   
   script bool FireWeapon(WsfTrack track)
      WsfWeapon w = PLATFORM.Weapon(w_name);
      if (w.IsValid()) {
         bool result = w.Fire(track);
         if (!result) writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Failed launch");
         else writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Launched");
         return result;
      }
      return false;
   end_script

   script bool CanEngage(WsfTrack track)
      WsfWeapon w = PLATFORM.Weapon(w_name);
      if (!w.IsValid() || !track.IsValid()) {
         writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Invalid weapon or track");
         return false;
      }
      if (track.Quality() < required_track_quality) {
         writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Low track quality: " + (string)track.Quality() + "/" + (string)required_track_quality);
         return false;
      }
      string category = w.AuxDataString("t_category");
      if (!category.Contains("any")) {
         if (track.AirDomain() && !category.Contains("air")) {
            writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Category does not match -> air");
            return false;
         }
         if (track.SurfaceDomain() && !category.Contains("surface")) {
            writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Category does not match -> surface");
            return false;
         }
      }
      double range = w.AuxDataDouble("range");
      if (track.CurrentLocation().SlantRangeTo(PLATFORM.Location()) > range) {
         writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " Too far " + (string)range);
         return false;
      }
      return true;
   end_script
   
   evaluation_interval WAITING 2 s
   evaluation_interval ENGAGE 10 s
   
   state WAITING
      next_state ENGAGE
         return CanEngage(TRACK);
      end_next_state
   end_state
   
   state ENGAGE
      next_state WAITING
         if (!CanEngage(TRACK)) return true;
         FireWeapon(TRACK);
         return false;
      end_next_state
   end_state
   
   script void on_task_assign(WsfTask aTask, WsfTrack aTrack)
      writeln("Assigned task");
   end_script
   
   
end_processor

文件路径: common\processors\air\air_behaviors.txt
============================================================

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 13, 2026.
include_once ../../util_scripts.txt

behavior chase_air_target
   script_variables
      extern double max_chase_speed; # m/s
      extern bool keep_distance;
      extern double distance_to_keep; # m
   end_script_variables
   precondition
      writeln_d("Testing chase");
      return PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().IsValid() &&
             PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().AirDomain();
   end_precondition
   execute
      PLATFORM.Comment("Chasing " + PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().TargetName());
      writeln_d("Chasing");
      WsfTrack target_track = PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack();
      double kp;
      if (keep_distance) kp = distance_to_keep;
      else kp = 0.0;
      double distance = PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(target_track);
      double speed_offset = PLATFORM.Speed() - target_track.Speed();
      WsfGeoPoint target_position = target_track.CurrentLocation();
      if (keep_distance) {
         double time_diff = distance_to_keep / target_track.Speed();
         if (distance - distance_to_keep < 10 && target_track.Speed() <= max_chase_speed)
            PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(target_track.Speed());
         else PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(max_chase_speed);
      }
      else {
         PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(max_chase_speed);
      }
      PlatformTurnToPoint(PLATFORM, target_position);
      PLATFORM.GoToAltitude(target_position.Altitude());
   end_execute
end_behavior

behavior cruise
   script_variables 
      extern double max_cruise_speed; # m/s
      extern double cruise_altitude; # m/s
      extern double minimum_cruise_distance; # m
   end_script_variables
   precondition
      writeln_d("Testing Cruise");
      return PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().IsValid() &&
             PLATFORM.GroundRangeTo(PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack()) >= minimum_cruise_distance;
   end_precondition
   execute 
      PLATFORM.Comment("Cruising " + PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().TargetName());
      writeln_d("Cruising");
      WsfTrack target_track = PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack();
      double distance = PLATFORM.GroundRangeTo(target_track);
      PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(max_cruise_speed);
      PlatformTurnToPoint(PLATFORM, target_track.CurrentLocation());
      PLATFORM.GoToAltitude(cruise_altitude);
   end_execute
end_behavior

behavior attacker_retreat_to_mother_ship
   script_variables 
      extern Array<WsfWeapon> attack_weapons;
      extern Array<int> weapon_refill_quantity;
      extern WsfPlatform mother_ship;
      extern double max_chase_speed; # m/s
      extern double max_cruise_speed; # m/s
      extern double cruise_altitude; # m
      extern double minimum_cruise_distance; # m
   end_script_variables
   precondition
      writeln_d("Testing Retreat");
      if (mother_ship.IsNull()) return false;
      if (!PLATFORM.HasCurrentTarget() || attack_weapons.IsNull()) return true;
      foreach (WsfWeapon w in attack_weapons) {
         if (w.QuantityRemaining() <= 0) return true;
      } 
      return false;
   end_precondition
   execute 
      PLATFORM.Comment("Retreating");
      writeln_d("Retreating");
      double distance_to_mother_ship = PLATFORM.GroundRangeTo(mother_ship);
         if (distance_to_mother_ship > minimum_cruise_distance) {
            PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(max_cruise_speed);
            PlatformTurnToPoint(PLATFORM, mother_ship.Location());
            PLATFORM.GoToAltitude(cruise_altitude);
         }
         else if (distance_to_mother_ship <= 10.0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < attack_weapons.Size(); i = i + 1) {
               attack_weapons.Get(i).SetQuantityRemaining(weapon_refill_quantity.Get(i));
            }
         }
         else {
            double distance = PLATFORM.SlantRangeTo(mother_ship);
            WsfGeoPoint target_position = mother_ship.Location();
            double target_speed = mother_ship.Speed() + distance / 10;
            if (target_speed > max_chase_speed) target_speed = max_chase_speed;
            PLATFORM.GoToSpeed(target_speed);
            PlatformTurnToPoint(PLATFORM, target_position);
            PLATFORM.GoToAltitude(target_position.Altitude());
         }
   end_execute
end_behavior

behavior evade_threats
   script_variables
      extern Array<WsfWeapon> evade_weapons;
      extern WsfThreatProcessor threat_processor;
   end_script_variables
   precondition 
      writeln_d("Testing evade");
      return threat_processor.NearestThreat().IsValid() && evade_weapons.IsValid() && !evade_weapons.Empty();
   end_precondition
   execute 
      writeln_d("Evading");
      Array<WsfTrackId> threat_ids = threat_processor.Threats();
      WsfLocalTrackList local_tracks = PLATFORM.MasterTrackList();
      foreach (WsfTrackId track_id in threat_ids) {
         WsfLocalTrack t = local_tracks.Find(track_id);
         foreach (WsfWeapon w in evade_weapons) {
            if (WeaponCanAttackTarget(w, t)) {
               ForceFireWeapon(w, t);
               break;
            }
         }
      }
   end_execute
end_behavior

behavior attack_target
   script_variables
      extern Array<WsfWeapon> attack_weapons;
   end_script_variables
   precondition 
      writeln_d("Testing attack");
      return PLATFORM.HasCurrentTarget() && attack_weapons.IsValid() && !attack_weapons.Empty();
   end_precondition
   execute 
      writeln_d("Attacking");
      foreach (WsfWeapon w in attack_weapons) {
         if (WeaponCanAttackTarget(w, PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack())) {
            if (ForceFireWeapon(w, PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack())) PLATFORM.ClearCurrentTarget();
            break;
         }
      }
   end_execute
end_behavior

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 13, 2026.
include_once ./air_behaviors.txt

processor FIGHTER_PROCESSOR WSF_QUANTUM_TASKER_PROCESSOR 
   script_debug_writes disable
   
   script_variables
      # Current task
      double task_interrupt_interval = 480;
      double current_task_receive_time = -99999;
      # attack_target
      Array<WsfWeapon> attack_weapons;
      # attacker_retreat_to_mother_ship
      WsfPlatform mother_ship;
      Array<int> weapon_refill_quantity;
      # chase_air_target
      double max_chase_speed; # m/s
      bool keep_distance;
      double distance_to_keep; # m
      # cruise
      double max_cruise_speed; # m/s
      double cruise_altitude; # m/s
      double minimum_cruise_distance; # m
      # evade_threats
      Array<WsfWeapon> evade_weapons;
      WsfThreatProcessor threat_processor;
   end_script_variables
   
   on_message 
      type WSF_TASK_ASSIGN_MESSAGE
         script 
            WsfTaskAssignMessage m = (WsfTaskAssignMessage) MESSAGE;
            if (m.Track().IsValid() && m.Track().Target().IsValid() && !m.Track().TargetKilled()) {
               if (TIME_NOW >= current_task_receive_time + task_interrupt_interval || 
                  !PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().IsValid() || PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().TargetKilled()) {
                  PLATFORM.SetCurrentTarget(m.Track());
                  current_task_receive_time = TIME_NOW;
               }
            }
            writeln_d(PLATFORM.Name() + " has received task (" + m.Track().TargetName() + ") from " + m.AssignerName());
         end_script
   end_on_message
   
   on_update
      if (PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().IsValid() && PLATFORM.CurrentTargetTrack().TargetKilled()) {
         PLATFORM.ClearCurrentTarget();
      }
   end_on_update
   

   

   behavior_tree 
      selector 
         behavior_node attacker_retreat_to_mother_ship
         parallel
            behavior_node evade_threats
            selector 
               behavior_node cruise
               behavior_node chase_air_target
            end_selector
            behavior_node attack_target
         end_parallel
      end_selector
   end_behavior_tree
end_processor

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 18, 2026.
include_once ../../util_scripts.txt

processor CARRIER_FLIGHT_PROCESSOR WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
   script_variables 
      int E2D_quantity = 8;
      int F35C_quantity = 18;
      int FA18E_quantity = 18;
      
      int preferred_E2D_num = 4;
      
      double take_off_interval = 180; # seconds
      double last_take_off_time = -9999;
   end_script_variables
   
   script bool PlaneTakeOff(string plane_type)
      return DeployPlatform(PLATFORM, plane_type, "air", "").IsValid();
   end_script
   
   on_update
      if (last_take_off_time + take_off_interval > TIME_NOW) return;
      int E2D_num = FindPlatformsOfType("E2D").Size();
      if (E2D_num < preferred_E2D_num && E2D_quantity > 0) {
         if (PlaneTakeOff("E2D")) E2D_quantity = E2D_quantity - 1;
      }
      else {
         double f35_ratio = F35C_quantity / (double) (F35C_quantity + FA18E_quantity);
         if (RANDOM.Uniform() <= f35_ratio && F35C_quantity > 0) {
            if (PlaneTakeOff("F35")) F35C_quantity = F35C_quantity - 1;
         }
         else if (FA18E_quantity > 0) {
            if (PlaneTakeOff("FA18E")) FA18E_quantity = FA18E_quantity - 1;
         }
      }
   end_on_update
   
   update_interval 180 s
end_processor

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 7, 2026.
antenna_pattern MID_SHORT_TRACK_ANTENNA
   rectangular_pattern
      peak_gain 32 db          # Slightly lower gain (trade-off for wider beam)
      minimum_gain -15 db
      azimuth_beamwidth 2 deg  # Wider beam for acquisition coverage
      elevation_beamwidth 2 deg
   end_rectangular_pattern
end_antenna_pattern

sensor MID_SHORT_TRACK_RADAR WSF_RADAR_SENSOR
   one_m2_detect_range 100 km  # Core detection range for 1m  target (ACQ)
   maximum_range 150 km        # Buffer range for acquisition
   
   frame_time 0.3 s              # Slightly slower frame time (acquisition prioritizes coverage over speed)
   
   scan_mode azimuth_and_elevation
   azimuth_scan_limits -45 deg 45 deg  # Wider scan range for area coverage
   elevation_scan_limits -15 deg 40 deg
   
   transmitter
      antenna_pattern MID_SHORT_ACQ_ANTENNA
      power 1000 kw            # Higher power for extended detection range
      frequency 8000 mhz       # X-band (balance of resolution and range)
      internal_loss 2 db
   end_transmitter
   
   receiver
      antenna_pattern MID_SHORT_ACQ_ANTENNA
      bandwidth 4 mhz          # Slightly narrower bandwidth (better SNR for longer range)
      noise_power -167 dbw     # Lower noise power (improved sensitivity)
      internal_loss 5 db
   end_receiver
   
   probability_of_false_alarm 1.0e-6
   required_pd 0.5
   swerling_case 1
   
   hits_to_establish_track 2 5
   hits_to_maintain_track 1 5
   
   track_quality 1.0                 # Moderate track quality (acquisition > precision)
   
   ignore_same_side
   # Report configuration (core data for target acquisition)
   reports_location
   reports_velocity
   reports_bearing
   reports_side
   reports_type
end_sensor

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 6, 2026.
include_once ../../signatures/missile_signature.txt
include_once ../basic_weapons.txt

# ==============================================
# AIM120 (Advanced Medium-Range Air-to-Air Missile)
# Medium-range, high-speed air-to-air missile for aerial combat
# ==============================================
weapon_effects AIM120_EFFECT WSF_GRADUATED_LETHALITY
   # Define kill probability (PK) based on distance from detonation
   # Radius: 50m (100% PK) -> 500m (0% PK) for air-to-air engagement
   radius_and_pk 50 m 1.0    # Within 50m: guaranteed kill
   radius_and_pk 100 m 0.9   # 90% kill probability at 100m
   radius_and_pk 200 m 0.7   # 70% kill probability at 200m
   radius_and_pk 300 m 0.5   # 50% kill probability at 300m
   radius_and_pk 400 m 0.2   # 20% kill probability at 400m
   radius_and_pk 500 m 0.0   # Beyond 500m: no kill chance
end_weapon_effects

platform_type AIM120 WSF_PLATFORM
   icon missile              # Visual icon type
   # Signature configuration (small missile with low detectability)
   radar_signature SMALL_MISSILE_RADAR_SIGNATURE
   infrared_signature SMALL_MISSILE_INFRARED_SIGNATURE
   optical_signature SMALL_MISSILE_OPTICAL_SIGNATURE
   category missile
   
   # Movement characteristics for air-to-air missile
   mover WSF_STRAIGHT_LINE_MOVER
      update_interval 0.5 s  # Update position every 0.5 seconds
      # Time-of-flight (TOF) vs speed profile (accelerates to supersonic)
      tof_and_speed 
         0.00 s 200 m/s      # Initial speed at launch
         10.0 s 400 m/s      # Speed after 10 seconds
         15.0 s 600 m/s      # Max speed (supersonic) at 15 seconds
      end_tof_and_speed
      maximum_lateral_acceleration 30.0 g  # High maneuverability for air targets
      guidance_mode lead_pursuit           # Lead pursuit for aerial intercept
   end_mover
   
   # Perfect tracker for target acquisition (simplified for simulation)
   processor tracker WSF_PERFECT_TRACKER
      update_interval 1.0 s  # Update target lock every 1 second
   end_processor
   
   # Air target fuse (detonate against aerial targets)
   processor fuse WSF_AIR_TARGET_FUSE 
      max_time_of_flight_to_detonate 150 s  # Self-destruct after nearly 3 mins
   end_processor
end_platform_type

# AIM120 launcher configuration (typical air-to-air missile loadout)
weapon AIM120_LAUNCHER BASIC_EXPLICIT_WEAPON 
   aux_data
      double range = 75000.0 # in meter
      string t_category = "air missile"
      double last_launch_time = -99999 # sim time
      double required_track_quality = 0.85
   end_aux_data
   launched_platform_type AIM120          # Link to AIM120 platform definition
   weapon_effects AIM120_EFFECT           # Link to AIM120 kill effects
   quantity 4                             # 4 missiles per launcher (e.g., F-16/F-18)
end_weapon

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 6, 2026.
# ==============================================
# AGM114 (Hellfire) - Anti-Armor/Anti-Tank Missile
# Short-range, precision-guided missile for ground/armor targets
# ==============================================
include_once ../../signatures/missile_signature.txt
include_once ../basic_weapons.txt

weapon_effects AGM114_EFFECT WSF_GRADUATED_LETHALITY
   # Smaller kill radius (anti-armor focus) - high PK at short range
   radius_and_pk 10 m 1.0     # Within 10m: guaranteed kill (anti-tank)
   radius_and_pk 20 m 0.9     # 90% PK at 20m
   radius_and_pk 30 m 0.7     # 70% PK at 30m
   radius_and_pk 40 m 0.5     # 50% PK at 40m
   radius_and_pk 50 m 0.2     # 20% PK at 50m
   radius_and_pk 60 m 0.0     # Beyond 60m: no kill chance
end_weapon_effects

platform_type AGM114 WSF_PLATFORM
   icon missile
   # Signature: small missile (helicopter-launched)
   radar_signature SMALL_MISSILE_RADAR_SIGNATURE
   infrared_signature SMALL_MISSILE_INFRARED_SIGNATURE
   optical_signature SMALL_MISSILE_OPTICAL_SIGNATURE
   category missile
   # Movement: low speed, short range, high precision
   mover WSF_STRAIGHT_LINE_MOVER
      update_interval 0.5 s   # Higher update rate for precision targeting
      tof_and_speed 
         0.00 s 150 m/s      # Initial launch speed (helicopter platform)
         5.0 s 360 m/s       # Max speed (subsonic)
         10.0 s 442 m/s      # Constant speed until impact
      end_tof_and_speed
      maximum_lateral_acceleration 10.0 g  # Lower maneuverability (ground targets)
      guidance_mode lead_pursuit
   end_mover
   
   # Precision tracker for armor/ground targets
   processor tracker WSF_PERFECT_TRACKER
      update_interval 0.5 s   # Faster tracking for close-range targets
   end_processor
   
   # Ground target fuse (detonate on impact with armor/ground)
   processor fuse WSF_GROUND_TARGET_FUSE 
      max_time_of_flight_to_detonate 120 s   # Self-destruct after 1 min
   end_processor
end_platform_type

# AGM114 launcher (helicopter loadout: e.g., AH-64 Apache)
weapon AGM114_LAUNCHER BASIC_EXPLICIT_WEAPON

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 6, 2026.
# ==============================================
# AGM158C (LRASM) - Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile
# Long-range, stealthy, subsonic anti-ship missile
# ==============================================
include_once ../../signatures/missile_signature.txt
include_once ../basic_weapons.txt

weapon_effects AGM158C_EFFECT WSF_GRADUATED_LETHALITY
   # Large kill radius for anti-ship (destroy warships)
   radius_and_pk 100 m 1.0    # Within 100m: guaranteed kill (warship)
   radius_and_pk 200 m 0.9    # 90% PK at 200m
   radius_and_pk 300 m 0.7    # 70% PK at 300m
   radius_and_pk 400 m 0.5    # 50% PK at 400m
   radius_and_pk 500 m 0.2    # 20% PK at 500m
   radius_and_pk 600 m 0.0    # Beyond 600m: no kill chance
end_weapon_effects

platform_type AGM158C WSF_PLATFORM
   icon missile
   # Stealth configuration (low detectability for long-range penetration)
   radar_signature SMALL_MISSILE_RADAR_SIGNATURE  # Stealth design
   infrared_signature SMALL_MISSILE_INFRARED_SIGNATURE # Low heat signature
   optical_signature SMALL_MISSILE_OPTICAL_SIGNATURE
   category missile
   mover WSF_STRAIGHT_LINE_MOVER
      update_interval 1.0 s   # Update position every 1 second
      tof_and_speed 
         0.00 s 200 m/s      # Initial launch speed
         30.0 s 280 m/s      # Cruise speed (subsonic)
         600.0 s 280 m/s     # Maintain speed for long range
      end_tof_and_speed
      maximum_lateral_acceleration 5.0 g    # Low maneuverability (cruise missile)
      guidance_mode lead_pursuit
   end_mover
   
   # Advanced tracker (stealth target acquisition)
   processor tracker WSF_PERFECT_TRACKER 
      update_interval 1.0 s   # Lower update rate for stealth
   end_processor
   
   # Naval target fuse (detonate on/near ships)
   processor fuse WSF_GROUND_TARGET_FUSE 
      max_time_of_flight_to_detonate 1800 s # Self-destruct after 30 mins
   end_processor
end_platform_type

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 6, 2026.
include_once ../../signatures/missile_signature.txt
include_once ../basic_weapons.txt

# ==============================================
# SA-3 / SAM-3 (S-125 Neva)
# Short-to-medium range, surface-to-air missile (SAM)
# ==============================================

weapon_effects SAM3_EFFECT WSF_GRADUATED_LETHALITY
   # Lethal radius vs air targets (aircraft, cruise missiles, UAVs)
   radius_and_pk  50 m 1.0    # Direct kill zone
   radius_and_pk 100 m 0.9
   radius_and_pk 150 m 0.7
   radius_and_pk 200 m 0.5
   radius_and_pk 250 m 0.2
   radius_and_pk 300 m 0.0    # Outside lethal range
end_weapon_effects

platform_type SAM3 WSF_PLATFORM
   icon missile
   # Surface-to-air missile signature
   radar_signature MEDIUM_MISSILE_RADAR_SIGNATURE
   infrared_signature MEDIUM_MISSILE_INFRARED_SIGNATURE
   optical_signature MEDIUM_MISSILE_OPTICAL_SIGNATURE
   category missile
   mover WSF_STRAIGHT_LINE_MOVER
      update_interval 0.1 s
      # Speed profile: boost to supersonic quickly, sustained speed
      tof_and_speed
          0.00 s 150 m/s
          5.00 s 900 m/s
         10.00 s 1900 m/s
      end_tof_and_speed
      maximum_lateral_acceleration 30.0 g   # Moderate maneuver for SAM
      guidance_mode lead_pursuit
   end_mover

   processor tracker WSF_PERFECT_TRACKER 
      update_interval 1.0 s
   end_processor

   processor fuse WSF_AIR_TARGET_FUSE
      max_time_of_flight_to_detonate 300 s   # Short flight time for short-range SAM
      time_of_flight_to_arm 5 s
   end_processor
   
   on_update 
      if (PLATFORM.MasterTrackList().Empty() ||
         !PLATFORM.MasterTrackList().Entry(0).IsValid()) PLATFORM.DeletePlatform();
   end_on_update

end_platform_type

# Typical SAM-3 launcher (4-missile battery configuration)
weapon SAM3_LAUNCHER BASIC_EXPLICIT_WEAPON
   aux_data
      double range = 120000.0 # in meter
      string t_category = "air missile"
   end_aux_data
   launched_platform_type SAM3
   weapon_effects SAM3_EFFECT
   quantity 4
end_weapon

# File generated by Wizard 2.9.0 on Mar 6, 2026.
include_once ../../signatures/missile_signature.txt
include_once ../../processors/cruise_missile_guider.txt
include_once ../basic_weapons.txt

# ==============================================
# Tomahawk (TLAM) - Cruise Missile
# Long-range, subsonic cruise missile for land/naval targets
# ==============================================
weapon_effects TOMAHAWK_EFFECT WSF_GRADUATED_LETHALITY
   # Large kill radius (bunker buster/area effect)
   radius_and_pk 150 m 1.0    # Within 150m: guaranteed kill
   radius_and_pk 250 m 0.9    # 90% PK at 250m
   radius_and_pk 350 m 0.7    # 70% PK at 350m
   radius_and_pk 450 m 0.5    # 50% PK at 450m
   radius_and_pk 550 m 0.2    # 20% PK at 550m
   radius_and_pk 650 m 0.0    # Beyond 650m: no kill chance
end_weapon_effects

platform_type TOMAHAWK WSF_PLATFORM
   icon missile
   # Signature: medium (stealth modified, but larger than LRASM)
   radar_signature MEDIUM_MISSILE_RADAR_SIGNATURE
   infrared_signature MEDIUM_MISSILE_INFRARED_SIGNATURE
   optical_signature MEDIUM_MISSILE_OPTICAL_SIGNATURE
   category missile
   # Long-range cruise movement (low altitude, constant speed)
   mover WSF_AIR_MOVER 
      update_interval 1.0 s
      minimum_altitude 10 m
   end_mover
   
   # Long-range tracker (satellite/GPS guided)
   processor tracker WSF_PERFECT_TRACKER 
      update_interval 1.0 s
   end_processor
   
   # Multi-target fuse (land/naval/bunker)
   processor fuse WSF_GROUND_TARGET_FUSE  
      max_time_of_flight_to_detonate 3600 s  # Self-destruct after 1 hour
      time_of_flight_to_arm 5 s
   end_processor
   
   processor guider CRUISE_MISSILE_GUIDER
   script_variables 
      cruise_height = 15;
      cruise_speed = 240;
      rise_speed = 180;
   end_script_variables
   end_processor
   
   on_update 
      if (PLATFORM.MasterTrackList().Empty() ||
         !PLATFORM.MasterTrackList().Entry(0).IsValid()) PLATFORM.DeletePlatform();
   end_on_update
end_platform_type

# Tomahawk launcher (naval vertical launch system - VLS)
weapon TOMAHAWK_LAUNCHER BASIC_EXPLICIT_WEAPON
   aux_data
      double range = 800000.0 # in meter
      string t_category = "surface"
   end_aux_data 
   launched_platform_type TOMAHAWK
   weapon_effects TOMAHAWK_EFFECT
   quantity 16                # 16 missiles per VLS cell group (destroyer/cruiser)
end_weapon
